# dynamodb-toolkit-koa (frozen re-export thunk)

> Superseded by the `dynamodb-toolkit/koa` subpath export (dynamodb-toolkit 3.8.0+). This package re-exports that subpath verbatim and receives no further development.

New code should import the subpath directly:

```js
import {createKoaAdapter} from 'dynamodb-toolkit/koa';
```

- API reference: https://github.com/uhop/dynamodb-toolkit/blob/master/llms.txt (§ Framework adapters)
- Full reference: https://github.com/uhop/dynamodb-toolkit/blob/master/llms-full.txt (§ 7.4)
- Wiki: https://github.com/uhop/dynamodb-toolkit/wiki/Koa-adapter
